name: – Victor Negrescu, Niclas Herbst – Joint text
title: REPORT on the joint text on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2025 approved by the Conciliation Committee under the budgetary procedure
part_text:
The European Parliament approved the European Union's budget for 2025. The budget sets total spending commitments at about 199.4 billion euros and planned payments at about 155.2 billion euros. It adds money for research, health, humanitarian aid, border management, security and disaster response, and funds 33 small trial projects. It also splits the Western Balkans growth fund into six country budgets. The Parliament also agreed joint statements with the Council and Commission on monitoring payments during the year.

- Extra money goes to research, health, humanitarian aid, borders, security and disaster response.
- It affects farmers, researchers, border agencies, disaster-hit regions and Western Balkan countries.
- The budget is adopted; payments linked to disaster aid wait for a new law.
